subject: Condominium Conversion Ordinance
overview: The subcommittee met to discuss paper 22-321, a proposal to enact a local condominium conversion ordinance in Medford. Members reviewed regional ordinance comparisons and passed motions requesting municipal data and staff feedback to guide future drafting.

items.title: Discussion on Condominium Conversion Ordinance Proposal
items.summary: Councilor Collins presented an overview and comparative analysis of condominium conversion ordinances from five Massachusetts municipalities, while city staff discussed local housing data, tax implications, and building code considerations.

items.title: Requests for Department Data and Staff Feedback
items.summary: The subcommittee approved motions requesting historical condo conversion data from city departments and soliciting staff feedback on policy goals and potential negative consequences to avoid.
